name: Fit the largest rectangle
about: The largest rectangles that fit a plot inside its setbacks, at any angle: the best and up to two others. Reads the space used as the plot and the line Plot setbacks (a Library Object on the plot's outline) draws inside it; a plot from before has its setbacks as its own values. Each candidate draws the rectangle as lines and a space used as the footprint: where the building goes, nothing built yet.
useWhen: A project's plot is drawn with Plot setbacks on it and the owner wants to know how big a building can go on it (the footprint), before any walls.

maxCoverage.name: Most of the plot to cover (0 to 1)
